notes.title: Life of A Yandere Simp Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Updates:
- Made a change so that at the end of the day students now play on their computer watching streams instead of standing in front of the wardrobe thinking of what to wear tomorrow.
- Made a change to the how to play menu to be less intimidating.
- Added new fanart into the art room

Bug fixes:
- Fixed vladimir talk option
- Fixed animations not playing after day reset

notes.title: Life of A Yandere Simp Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Updates:

- using the mobile menu now pauses the game
- scrolling speed increased in menus
- changed probability of students being rivals so instead of there being 10-14 rivals per round,
there should only be 2-8 rivals per round.
- increased the number of students than can be killed before school safety drops to zero.
- when choosing opposite gender, the dormplates for the opposite gender room will be renamed to vacant to avoid confusion for new players.

notes.title: Life of A Yandere Simp Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Updates:
- Improved visibility AI for enemies.
- Escape button no longer restarts the game. The button is now inside the mobile menu.
- Credits updated

Bug fixes:
- fixed an issue where one of the gameover screens would show the wrong character gender.
- fixed an issue where if multiple students are within talking range, sometimes you can get the task of one of them and the profile of someone else
- Fixed Tatiana's task.
- Evelyn dormplate name missing fixed
- Simp police now chases you again
- Some typo fixes
